subject: Request to remove conversation traces for NexHealth project
messages:
From: Ava Larkin <ava.larkin@nexhealth.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: legal@nexhealth.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remove conversation traces for 'patient-summaries' project

Hi Jordan,

We need Redwood to remove all prompt/response traces, request logs, and associated inference artifacts tied to our 'patient-summaries' workspace (workspace id: nh-prod-07) as part of a data minimization request from our privacy team. Specifically:
- All prompt and model output logs from 2026-09-01 to 2027-04-04
- Per-request metadata and request IDs (not aggregate metrics)
- Any cached KV/prefix entries and transient embeddings generated for that workspace

Can you provide the deletion plan, timelines, and an audit manifest once completed? Legal wants a signed confirmation and a simple manifest that lists deleted S3 prefixes or database record ranges.

Thanks,
Ava Larkin
Data Privacy Lead — NexHealth
ava.larkin@nexhealth.com

--
Note: please include the DocuSign link if a signature is required.

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com
To: Ava Larkin <ava.larkin@nexhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove conversation traces for 'patient-summaries' project

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear outline. I've looped in Marissa from Account and Neha from Security/Compliance. High-level plan below; Neha will provide technical details and a tentative timeline.

Top-level approach:
- Scope verification (1 business day): confirm exact workspace id and any cross-account artifacts.
- Targeted deletion (2–3 business days after scope sign-off): remove prompt/output logs, request metadata, cached KV entries, and embeddings produced for nh-prod-07.
- Manifest + audit stub (delivered same day as deletion): CSV manifest listing deleted prefixes and object keys, plus a short audit text file with who/when.

If Legal needs a DocuSign sign-off, we can attach the manifest to the DocuSign envelope. Will that work?

Action items:
- Ava: confirm workspace id and whether any exports were shared with other downstream systems (SFTP, BigQuery, partner buckets).
- Marissa: confirm commercial approvals for any manual work (this is a standard compliance request; no charge if within retention/contract).
- Neha: provide the exact deletion commands, S3 prefixes, and timeline.

I'll hold for confirmation and will reply with the INF ticket once Neha confirms.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: none in this message

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Ava Larkin <ava.larkin@nexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: remove conversation traces for 'patient-summaries' project

Thanks — scope verified (nh-prod-07). Internal notes and proposed execution plan below.

Scope details (what we'll delete):
- S3 buckets: s3://redwood-logs/nh-prod-07/prompts/ (YYYY/MM/DD keys between 2026-09-01 and 2027-04-04)
- Model outputs: s3://redwood-logs/nh-prod-07/outputs/ (same date range)
- Request metadata rows in infra.requests table where workspace_id = 'nh-prod-07' and created_at between dates above
- KV cache entries prefixed nh-prod-07:kv:* and transient embeddings in embeddings-store with workspace_tag nh-prod-07

Execution plan:
1) Create INF ticket and snapshot list (INF-4821) — contains object keys and query statements. (30–60m)
2) Run snapshot and verify counts; take immutable audit snapshot (we keep the snapshot for compliance but will not expose it externally). (1–2h)
3) Run deletion job (idempotent delete scripts; S3 delete with versioning checks). (2–4h)
4) Post-deletion verification: run the same snapshot queries to confirm zero results; produce deletion_manifest.csv and deletion_audit_log_stub.txt. (1h)

Estimated calendar timeline: if Ava confirms no downstream exports by 11:00 PT today, we can start snapshots today and finish by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-06).

Attachments to expect after run: deletion_manifest.csv (object keys / query ids), deletion_audit_log_stub.txt (who/when/command hashes), INF-4821-snapshot-list.txt.

Safety checks / caveats:
- If any objects were replicated to other AWS accounts or external partner buckets, we need written confirmation from the partner to delete — otherwise we can delete only our primary copies and note the replication locations in the manifest.
- Cached embeddings used by downstream indexing services will be wiped; customers should confirm that any reindexing is acceptable.

I'll open INF-4821 now and update with progress. Marissa — if you could confirm there are no billing/contract constraints, we can proceed.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

--
